Brand story

Who Uriel is

Uriel is a data engineering and AI solopreneur. He leads and coordinates data projects end to end, conception to deploy: designing pipelines, tuning databases, delivering analytics.

Alongside client work, he writes about data, tech, AI, and project management on Medium and Substack, sharing real decisions and real numbers rather than theory.

The visual identity reflects that: monochromatic, technical, no decoration. What you see is what the work looks like.

ProfileSolopreneur + Freelancer, solo operation
ServesCompanies, per-project consulting
Also runsMedium, Substack, Buy Me a Coffee

Logo

Primary mark

ON LIGHT — uriel-logo.png
ON DARK — uriel-logo-nobg.png
Clear space: keep padding around the mark at least equal to the height of the mark's dot (the "i" node). Never let text or edges enter this zone.
Min. width: 24px digital / 15mm print
Uriel Brand Guidelines — p. 4v1.0 — 2026
Logo

Don'ts

Don't stretch or distort
Don't recolor — monochrome only
Don't add shadows or effects
Don't place on busy backgrounds
Don't crop the mark
Don't lower contrast / wordmark must stay legible
Uriel Brand Guidelines — p. 5v1.0 — 2026
Colors

Palette

Monochromatic only. No primary colors, no accent colors — clean, minimal, technical.

Primary — strokes & text
Primary#5F5F5F
Variation#606060
Smooth curves#626262
Light mode backgrounds
Pure white#FFFFFF
Soft background#F5F5F5
Slightly darker#EFEFEF
Dark mode
Background#000000
Near-black softened#1A1A1A
Light stroke#BFBFBF
Highlight variation#CFCFCF
Forbidden
Any saturated / primary accent color
Gradients or brand blues/greens

Typography

Type system

FRAUNCES — display & titles: name on homepage, headings, article titles, lede paragraph
Aa Bb Cc Dd Ee Ff Gg — 0123456789
INTER — body: all paragraphs, descriptions, nav links, definition lists
Aa Bb Cc Dd Ee Ff Gg — 0123456789
JETBRAINS MONO — metadata & labels: section labels, detail keys, reading times, footer
Aa Bb Cc Dd Ee Ff Gg — 0123456789
H1Heading one
H2Heading two
BODYBody copy sits here, short paragraphs, direct sentences.
CAPTIONCAPTION / LABEL / METADATA
Uriel Brand Guidelines — p. 7v1.0 — 2026
Voice & tone

How the brand talks

Direct Personal Narrative Technical but human No hedging
DO

"I migrated the pipeline off Fabric because latency was killing the client's dashboards. Three weeks, no rollback."

DON'T

"Leveraging cutting-edge synergies, we disrupted the data pipeline landscape."

DO

"Here's the query that cut the report from 40 seconds to 2."

DON'T

"It's worth noting that, in conclusion, performance was impactfully improved."

DO

Short paragraphs. First person. Real numbers, real projects, problem → solution.

DON'T

Em dashes, emojis, guru jargon, soft vague conclusions.

Gaps

What's still missing

01No photography or imagery style defined yet beyond the logo assets — add real work photos or screenshots when available.
02Font files (Fraunces, Inter, JetBrains Mono) are not stored locally in the identity folder — this book uses the Google Fonts web versions as a stand-in.
03No published content samples found in areas/marketing/ yet — once carousels or thumbnails exist, add them to the Applications page.
04No icon-only / favicon variant of the mark exists yet, separate from the full wordmark lockup.
